source.conversion: Alpha-framed, 2x supersampled unlit 2D particle flipbooks using authored Built-in noise, masks, emission, UV animation and Fresnel. Pure additive clips retain additive blending; mixed clips use a normal-alpha approximation. HDR bloom and screen-space refraction are not reproduced.
